name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 3 – Am 39
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 3a. Recalls that discrimination based on sex and other grounds is prohibited under Article 21 of the Charter; expresses serious concern about the erosion of the meaning of fundamental rights and gender equality; calls on the Commission and the Member States to refrain from adopting the narrative of gender ideology and the LGBTIQ+ lobby, aimed at eliminating sex-based rights, language and legal categories in law and policy; warns against the risk of classifying highly controversial issues as fundamental rights, such as surrogacy or so-called gender-affirming interventions without age limits, and underlines the need to act, in this regard, in full respect of the Treaties and the principle of subsidiarity;
